fda_section: Boxed Warning, Contraindications, Warnings and Precautions
labeling_action: Genetic testing required prior to initiation. Contraindicated in HLA-B*57:01 positive patients.
Screening recommended prior to treatment in patients of genetically at-risk ancestry.

fda_section: Boxed Warning, Dosage and Administration, Clinical Pharmacology
labeling_action: Diminished antiplatelet effect in CYP2C19 poor metabolizers; consider alternative P2Y12 inhibitor.

fda_section: Boxed Warning, Contraindications, Warnings and Precautions
labeling_action: Contraindicated in pediatric patients for post-operative tonsillectomy/adenoidectomy pain and ultra-rapid metabolizers.
Increased risk of severe, life-threatening, or fatal toxicities in patients with certain homozygous or certain compound heterozygous DPYD variants.
Lower initial doses recommended for patients with CYP2C9 and VKORC1 variants.
